gates.requirement: Every adapter declares encode, enumerate, refine, address, intervene, decode, support, project, measure, perturb, and account as available or unavailable.
No external capture becomes a DSQ or RefinementGraph without complete bounded refinement evidence.
Changing Samplebrain block size is not a refinement certificate.
EnCodec spans, prefixes, frames, codebooks, and tokens remain candidates until mapping and intervention evidence close.
Every captured run binds source digest, target revision, configuration, native unit, explicit resampling, evidence class, and opaque fields.
Probe reads only explicit regular files under explicit roots and performs no subprocess, network, model, or playback action.
Timeout, refusal, malformed capture, silent resampling, and unavailable operations emit durable receipts without an authoritative representation derivative.
External tool, environment, checkpoint, and aggregate license availability remain independent explicit states.
